Energetics and prey data

Source: R/datasets.R
energeticsandpreydata.Rd

Species-specific parameters used by seabORD: body mass, mortality and abandonment thresholds, time budgets, energetics, prey intake and mass-survival parameters, and expected outcomes in poor, moderate and good years. Descriptions follow the package metadata table in R/functions-transform2seabord.R.

Usage

energeticsandpreydata

Format

A data frame with the following 38 columns:

Code

Character: Two-letter species code.

Species

Character: Species name.

BM_adult_mn

Numeric: Initial adult body mass, mean (g).

BM_adult_sd

Numeric: Initial adult body mass, standard deviation (g).

BM_adult_mortf

Numeric: Critical body mass below which an adult is assumed dead (proportion of mean mass).

BM_adult_abdn

Numeric: Critical body mass below which an adult abandons its chick (proportion of mean mass).

BM_chick_mn

Numeric: Initial chick body mass, mean (g).

BM_chick_sd

Numeric: Initial chick body mass, standard deviation (g).

BM_Chick_mortf

Numeric: Critical body mass below which a chick dies (proportion of initial mass).

daylength

Numeric: Number of hours per time step.

seasonlength

Numeric: Number of time steps per season.

unattend_max_hrs

Numeric: Time a chick can be left unattended before it is assumed to die from exposure or predation (hours).

adult_DEE_mn

Numeric: Adult daily energy expenditure, mean (kJ).

adult_DEE_sd

Numeric: Adult daily energy expenditure, standard deviation (kJ).

chick_DER

Numeric: Chick daily energy requirement (kJ per day).

IR_max

Numeric: Maximum prey intake rate (g per minute).

IR_half_a

Numeric: Intake-rate half-saturation parameter a (scales the half-saturation constant with competition).

IR_half_b

Numeric: Intake-rate half-saturation parameter b (exponent applied to the competition factor).

flight_msec

Numeric: Average flight speed (metres per second).

assim_eff

Numeric: Assimilation efficiency (proportion).

energy_prey

Numeric: Energy gained from prey (kJ per gram).

energy_nest

Numeric: Energy cost of nesting at the colony (kJ per day).

energy_flight

Numeric: Energy cost of flight (kJ per day).

energy_searest

Numeric: Energy cost of resting at sea (kJ per day).

energy_forage

Numeric: Energy cost of foraging (kJ per day).

energy_warming

Numeric: Energy cost of warming food (kJ per day).

chick_mass_a

Numeric: Maximum chick mass gain per day (g).

adult_mass_KG

Numeric: Energy density of adult bird tissue (kJ per gram).

beta

Numeric: Mass-survival slope (parameter of the mass-survival relationship).

basesurv_poor

Numeric: Baseline adult survival in poor years (mass-survival relationship).

basesurv_modr

Numeric: Baseline adult survival in moderate years (mass-survival relationship).

basesurv_good

Numeric: Baseline adult survival in good years (mass-survival relationship).

massloss_poor

Numeric: Expected adult body mass loss in poor years (percent).

massloss_modr

Numeric: Expected adult body mass loss in moderate years (percent).

massloss_good

Numeric: Expected adult body mass loss in good years (percent).

chicksurv_poor

Numeric: Expected chick survival in poor years (percent).

chicksurv_modr

Numeric: Expected chick survival in moderate years (percent).

chicksurv_good

Numeric: Expected chick survival in good years (percent).

Source

Species parameters compiled for seabORD from the publishedstudies cited in the model description.
